identity: The Moonfall Observatory charts the stars over a wood that someone is quietly emptying with marked snares.

quests.title: [PH] Sound Wood
quests.text: [PH] Lethen Moonledger replaces split sighting posts: bring 15 Wooden Planks of any wood. Real text to follow.

variants.text: [PH] Lethen Moonledger replaces split sighting posts: bring 15 Wooden Planks of any wood. Real text to follow.
[PH] Tokai Knotreader needs lids for the fish traps instead of crab shells: bring 15 Wooden Planks of any wood. Real text to follow.

quests.lesson: A shared material errand: planks of any wood.
quests.notes: Round 60 BANDQUESTS. Draft §3 'Brauchbares Holz' (Lethen's sighting posts, Tokai's trap lids).

quests.title: [PH] A Pane Without a Crack
quests.text: [PH] Lethen Moonledger needs Glass for the shield pane of an instrument; the player brings the material, Lethen does the work: bring 6 Glass. Real text to follow.
quests.lesson: The zone's first errand, a level only; the early potion choice.
quests.notes: Round 60 BANDQUESTS. Free play, a level only.

quests.title: [PH] A Fixed Point of Reference
quests.text: [PH] Lethen wants the prepared sighting frame set up at the {name:sighting_post} in the {name:deepwood}, a reference the false forest signs cannot move. Real text to follow.
quests.completion: [PH] Lethen has a point to measure from again. Real text to follow.
quests.lesson: A use at a place or a day hunt; the first armor choice (one enchant, a prefix).
quests.notes: Round 60 BANDQUESTS. Free play, a level only.

quests.title: [PH] Ladders for the Platforms
quests.text: [PH] Lethen's observers climb to their platforms on rungs older than his patience: bring 10 Wooden Ladders. Real text to follow.
quests.lesson: A later errand or use; the second armor choice (one enchant, a suffix).
quests.notes: Round 60 BANDQUESTS. Free play, a level only.

quests.title: [PH] A Warden in Name Alone
quests.text: [PH] Lethen sends the player against Poacher Snarewarden Bracken in the {name:elderwood}, who deals with Vetch and Rusk; their fall is not assumed. Real text to follow.
quests.completion: [PH] Bracken's false signs come down with him. Real text to follow.
quests.lesson: The named leader; the weapon choice (prefix and suffix).
quests.notes: Round 60 BANDQUESTS. The id stays (its objectives are unchanged).

quests.title: [PH] The Trade Beyond the Wood
quests.text: [PH] Lethen sends the player to Faeris Rootbinder at Glassroot Gate, where Bracken's trade reaches; his case is not claimed. Real text to follow.
quests.lesson: A travel quest, free (a level only).
quests.notes: Round 60 BANDQUESTS. The departure id stays; free from 29, it requires nothing.
